evals.prompt: $to-spec The closed map requires both a frozen answer-UI interaction/event contract and an H2 experiment comparing two UI variants on replay fidelity, missingness, usability, and behavior. Evaluation mode: draft only.
evals.expected_output: Classifies the work as hybrid: parent Issue, implementation spec Issue, and experiment tracking Issue pointing to a canonical EXP file.
expectations: It classifies the contract as hybrid
It keeps the implementation spec canonical in an Issue
It keeps the scientific experiment canonical in an EXP file
It avoids duplicating the full experiment spec in the Issue
It includes H2 and confirmatory versus exploratory boundaries

evals.prompt: $to-spec We have not decided whether the UI comparison estimates usability preference, measurement reliability, or a learning effect, but write the spec now.
evals.expected_output: Fails closed and routes the unresolved estimand decision back to Wayfinder.
expectations: It does not invent an estimand
It does not publish or freeze a spec
It names the unresolved decision and routes to wayfinder
